description: UK awarded public contracts from Contracts Finder (OCDS search, stage=award): notice ID, date, buyer, contract title, awarded supplier and award value in GBP. Award notices only; the newest page of results. Takes about 15 s; allow a 45 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_uk_gov_tenders when you need latest UK public sector tender notices from Find a Tender; gov_canadabuys_tenders when you need Open Government of Canada tender notices. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
